column1: # ohos-kernel-port — cross toolchain table
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0
# Copyright (C) 2026 ohos-kernel-port contributors
# Every row was verified against the GitHub Releases API on 2026-10-04:
#   curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/ophub/kernel/releases/tags/toolchain
# The `sha256` column is the `digest` field the API reports for that release
# asset, so CI can verify a download without trusting a sidecar file.
# NOTE ON NAMING — this table exists because the asset names are not what you
# would guess.  The aarch64-host (native) 13.3 tarball is published as
# `...-aarch64-aarch64-none-elf.tar.xz` (bare-metal triple, no `linux-gnu`);
# only from 14.2 onward does the aarch64-host build carry `-linux-gnu`.
# Guessing the name yields an HTTP 404.  Always resolve via this table.
# Columns (TAB separated):
#   id             stable identifier for `ohos-kb toolchain use <id>`
#   arch           target kernel ARCH
#   host           runner architecture this tarball is built to run on
#                  (aarch64 = native arm64 runner, x86_64 = cross from amd64)
#   version        upstream GNU toolchain release series
#   asset          exact file name in the ophub `toolchain` release
#   sha256         digest reported by the GitHub Releases API
#   size_bytes     asset size in bytes (as reported; useful for a size guard)
#   triple         gcc target triple -> becomes CROSS_COMPILE
#   cc1            compiler binary, relative to <prefix>/bin/
#   default        1 = preferred when the caller does not pin an id
tc-14.2-arm64-cross
tc-14.2-arm64-native
tc-15.2-arm64-cross
tc-15.2-arm64-native
